scope: Hobart’s current officeholders, three 2026 ordinary election results and the deputy lord mayor selection process.

sources.title: City of Hobart current elected members
sources.supports: Current directory lists Charles Wooley as Lord Mayor and eight other councillors. It shows no Deputy Lord Mayor. Each name links to an individual council profile.

sources.title: TEC 2026 Hobart City Council election results
sources.supports: The three final Hobart tables were read in the cloud browser. They record first preferences, elected councillors, and the final counts for the Lord Mayor and Deputy Lord Mayor ballots.

sources.title: TEC 2026 council election timetable and certificate dates
sources.supports: Hobart City is in the 3 November 2026 certificate issue group in the electoral advertising return table. The table is evidence of the issue date.

sources.title: TEC 2026 Hobart City Council candidates
sources.supports: Hobart candidates page lists 32 councillor, 11 Lord Mayor and 10 Deputy Lord Mayor candidacies.

sources.title: Tasmanian Local Government Act 1993, sections 41 and 44
sources.supports: Section 41(4) requires a person accepting the office of mayor or deputy mayor to be a councillor. Section 44(4) provides for councillors to elect one of their number to a vacant deputy mayor office.

contestResults.finalResult: The final count returned nine councillors.
Charles Wooley won the Lord Mayor contest with 55.04% in the final count.

Ben Lohberger won the deputy ballot with 56.87% in the final count. He did not win a councillor seat and could not take up the office under section 41(4) of the Local Government Act 1993. Section 44(4) provides for the elected councillors to fill the vacant office.

limits: All nine profile URLs were read from the City directory. Six profile targets could not be independently loaded. Their current office and link destinations are sourced to the roster; the public name links use the directory for those six.
The TEC certificate issue date was verified in its date table. The individual certificate copy was unavailable in the checked source views.
No City agenda was available to verify a date or nomination list for the internal Deputy Lord Mayor selection. No date, nominee or winner is recorded for that selection.
